add.name: Will-O-Wisp
add.description: Summons have ghastly skulls orbiting them, inflicting Burning on hit for a portion of the summon's damage. Burning Damage 50%, Projectiles 8

add.name: Ghost Crew
add.description: Summons have a chance on hit to summon a Ghost Crew member to fight on your side for a short duration. Fire Damage 22914, Life 24000, Proc Chance 6%

add.name: Phantom Momentum
add.description: Gain stacks of Phantom Momentum while moving, providing increased movement speed and dodge chance; lose the stacks once you get hit. Movement Speed 3%, Dodge Chance 1%

add.name: Scarlet Sacrifice
add.description: Summons have a chance when attacking to become enraged, gaining increased damage and attack speed; enraged summons die after a short duration. Damage 75%, Attack Speed 50%, Proc Chance 4%

add.name: Heart Surge
add.description: When you cast, a floating projectile of blood is created; after a short delay when you stop casting, all of these projectiles are launched forward. Cold Damage 12120, Chance to fork on hit 28%

add.name: Spectral Scatter
add.description: Your ranged projectiles fork after a short delay, dealing increased damage. Damage 25%, Projectiles 4

add.name: Demon Form
add.description: Transform into a demon, increasing your attack damage and attack speed.

Reaper's Culling.description: You can no longer critically hit or miss the target and now deal increased physical damage. Culling is always 100% and no longer scales with star or skill levels.
